properties.verseOrder: v1 c1 v2 v3 o1 o2

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Lord, You are a stream of purest water
Blessing grows in beauty by Your side
From the rising of the sun
Until the day is done
In Your Word, oh Lord, I will abide

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
I delight in You, I delight in You
Like water, You satisfy my soul
I delight in You, I delight in You
Oh day and night, I delight in You

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Keep me from the counsel of the wicked
Keep Your light upon the ancient path
The chaff will blow away
And all the flowers fade
But only You and Your word will last

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Lord, You know my heart is prone to wander
Lord, You know my feet have gone astray
Though my flesh may fail
Every sin was nailed to the cross
Now I will sing

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
I want to be like a tree
Planted by the streams of purest water
Whose leaf does not wither
So I will build my house upon the rock
Of Your word and not on sinking sand
So I will stand

verse.name: o2
verse.lines:
You have loved me with an everlasting love
You have drawn me with Your lovingkindness

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
The world will pass away
And all the flowers fade
But only You and Your word will last
